body.p: After . Owns new tests/xsd/driver/, tests/xsd/slice.txt, tests/xsd/slice-baseline.txt, new tools/run-xsd.sh, tools/conformance-report.py (its XSD section), docs/QT4_CATALOG.md (an XSTS section). Program sxml-xsd-test on the CLI framework, a sibling of sxml-qt4 and sxml-xslt-test (), linking sxml_qt4_driver_library for reports and documents. Reads third_party/xsdtests/suite.xml and its .testSet files (namespace http://www.w3.org/XML/2004/xml-schema-test-suite/): test groups, schema tests (one or more schemaDocuments, compiled as one schema: valid means it compiles) and instance tests (validated against the group's schema, strict, with a report sink; an instance test of a group whose schema fails is a fail), applicability as above. list works now; run reports "XSD not implemented" (an unsupported outcome) until 5.4 compiles and 5.7 validates. tools/run-xsd.sh imitates tools/run-xslt.sh: one process per test set, reports in build/qt4-run/XSD11/, spec name XSD11 in the dashboard with the contributor groups as areas. Done when all 41,538 in-scope tests resolve (documents found, outcome read), a ctest slice of about 150 tests over every contributor is chosen with a baseline file (0), and the report JSON matches the QT4 driver's shape. Done 2026-10-18 (): sxml-xsd-test list and run; the drivers' common mechanisms shared in the QT4 driver's library (test budget, test selection, slice script); 41,518 tests in scope ( applies the version tokens per element; 's 41,538 or-ed them), every one resolves and is not run, "XSD not implemented"; tests/xsd/slice.txt, 147 tests, baseline 0; tools/run-xsd.sh (45 s) and the XSD11 dashboard section.
